monsterCoverage.scope: All concrete monster-tree descendants except abstract-intended BaseEnraged helper; GiantRat; nine champion tables and combat encounter helpers.
excludedCategories: Vendors, trainers, ordinary town NPCs and animals outside champion rosters and the monster tree.

adaptation.eligibilityNote: Standalone arena uses class exclusions and additionally excludes survivor bosses; server map/expansion/fame rolls are replaced.

items.name: Lieutenant Of The Britannian Royal Guard

limitations: Static source inheritance and literal constructor assignments; runtime-generated properties, material bonuses, quest state and arbitrary expressions are not evaluated.
AOS getters are used; Old-era values are excluded. Era labels from source paths/expansion tokens are conservative provenance hints.
Weapon/armor layers assigned by ItemData require client layer verification; fallback class conventions are labeled.
Bounds and quantization are source values; original selection groups, luck scaling, material exclusions and runic intensity distribution are not reimplemented.
Clothing outside BaseHat has no original runic affix table. A survivor mapping must be labeled as an adaptation.
Fixed predefined artifacts must not receive additional random affixes.

armor.name: Lieutenant Of The Britannian Royal Guard

Vas Flam. Turn the horde to ash.

The dead offer power to those who listen.
Hold the line beneath the virtues.
A precise blade against impossible numbers.
Move like shadow; strike without warning.
